show.sharing_text: हेलो! मैंने कुकू एफएम पर इस शो को सुना और मेरे ख्‍याल से आपको भी पसंद आएगा
show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/g8pxLM
show.description: Prakash, a humble village watchman, hides a legendary past as the "Mahaveeran," a supreme master of divine power who vanished decades ago. When the ancient, apocalyptic force known as Kaal returns to consume the kingdom, Prakash’s estranged son, Vikram, must lead a desperate army against an enemy they cannot defeat. Forced to step out of the shadows to save his son and the world, Prakash reveals his true identity to dismantle Kaal’s darkness
